title: Ref
description: An exact reference to an input (docs/design/m0/10 "Refs and fingerprints"). identity_digest is the JCS digest of every other field, so a change of revision, scope, lineage or restrictions changes the identity even when the bytes are identical; internal/knowledge computes and checks it. Content deduplication never merges restrictions.

id.description: A digest, a git id and path, or a controller id, by type.

revision.description: E.g. an adopted contract revision; null when the type has none.

framework.description: Framework scope: about auto-dev-cycle itself, never a project's code or domain.

lineage.description: The ids of the refs this one was derived from, recorded by the controller.

restrictions.description: Source restrictions inherited through lineage (KA1): one per contributing project, kept wherever the ref goes.

Restriction.description: The data policy of a contributing project when the ref was derived from it: a receiving project and destination must satisfy every restriction at each delivery.

policy_digest.description: Of the project's adopted data policy.

allowed_destinations.description: Resolved destinations (never empty-means-derived here: the controller resolves them when it records the restriction).
